title: Filipino Sari-sari Starter Catalog
description: 208 common Philippine basic-necessity and sari-sari products with broad categories and positive suggested starting prices. Prices are dated DTI SRPs or exact-product Philippine retailer observations and remain editable by the store owner.
dataLicense: Mixed-source factual data; see ATTRIBUTION.md for provenance
imageLicense: Open Food Facts product images: CC-BY-SA-3.0
attribution: The pack combines factual name, unit, and historical SRP records from the Philippine DTI with 20 Open Food Facts product records and images. Exact-product retailer observations fill prices not covered by the DTI bulletin. Every price retains its source and date.
